propositions: Commit d9e0f0e733 introduced unconditional top-level imports of git_adapter in _advisory_lock.py:83 and _ref_lock.py:194, breaking standalone-by-path execution mode where rebar_reconciler package is intentionally unavailable.

Bridge preview lock test fails with ModuleNotFoundError at _advisory_lock._lock_remote because the module is loaded by file path without package context, causing the absolute import to abort before lock acquisition executes.
Both standalone seams must use lazy_load("rebar_reconciler.git_adapter", "git_adapter.py") to restore the shared sys.modules key and preserve module identity with package-context importers.
Package-context and standalone-loaded execution paths must converge on a single git_adapter module object in sys.modules to maintain adapter API identity and lock semantics across all callers.
